title: The Lion and the Mouse

pages.text: Once upon a time, a great lion was sleeping peacefully in the deep green forest.
A little mouse started playing on him, jumping up and down, waking the lion up!
The lion was very angry and caught the tiny mouse with his huge, sharp-clawed paw.
'Please let me go!' cried the mouse. 'I promise that someday I may help you in return.'
The lion laughed at the idea of a tiny mouse helping him, but he kindly let the mouse go.

moral: No act of kindness, no matter how small, is ever wasted.
